sources.purpose: External v42 header extension per Nokia runtime; original metric and bitmap decoder unchanged. This is not upstream EKA2L1 v42 support.

checks: v1 full pixels/metrics/codes monobit and rust
v2 full pixels/metrics/codes monobit and rust
pdb full pixels/metrics/codes monobit and rust
prc full pixels/metrics/codes monobit and rust
FontConv afnx/FontSubst reader and native afnx/nfnt2 writer, all mapped glyphs
FontConv original six GrayFont profiles, rotations, compression and aliased bitmap indexes; Gray1/2 writer independently unpacked by Pillow
GDR39/40/41 writer all pixels/mappings/metrics checked by unmodified EKA2L1 loader; original Symbian fnttran41 output decoded with equivalent positioned ink and advances
GDR42 full pixels/metrics/codes checked by external EKA2L1 decoder with documented five-byte header extension; original native bitmap decoder unchanged; this extension is not upstream support
known_oracle_differences: monobit 0.54 afnx swaps one-byte offset/advance fields; its advance 0 disagrees with original FontConv advance 2. FontConv validates afnx.
monobit 0.54 high-density missing ff/ff entry becomes phantom code 66: sentinels are tested after scaling. Compare all real codes and assert this extra explicitly.
monobit GrayFont module has no registered complete reader and no writer; monobit has no GDR codec. Neither is claimed as oracle support.
